what: The text of the Thornswood collection's page on Nexus Mods: its summary, its description and its install steps, as New-NexusRevision sends them with every revision (scripts/release/collection-page.js says how). A mod is named [[the words|its Nexus mod id]], and every one has to be a mod records/collection.json installs. notSaid is what the build has made untrue, each with why. revision is the record's revision the page was read against.
summary: Mod list for the Thornswood co-op roleplay server on Skyrim Special Edition. Vortex installs it into a profile of its own, and the Thornswood launcher plays it on the build the server runs.
description:
## What this is

Thornswood is a co-op roleplay server for Skyrim Special Edition. This collection is the mod list the server checks against.

Vortex installs everything into a profile of its own, so your normal Skyrim stays as you left it. Switch to the Thornswood profile to play, switch back when you are done, and Purge Mods puts your game folder back.

Your Steam copy of Skyrim can be on any build. The Thornswood launcher from https://thornswood.net plays on 1.6.1170, the build the server runs: its Downgrade button asks Steam for that build's files and puts them in Thornswood's own game folder, and leaves your Steam copy alone.

Use the launcher to play. It signs you in with Discord, checks your mods against the server and starts the game. Do not start Thornswood with SkyrimSE.exe or skse64_loader.exe.

## What is in it

- Cities and towns: [[JK's Skyrim|6289]] with its Outskirts, [[Capital Windhelm Expansion|42990]], [[The City of Crossed Daggers|168629]], [[The Great City of Solitude|22243]], [[Skyrim Sewers|9320]] and [[The Solitude Arena|18692]]. [[Oakwood|61007]], [[Granite Hill|14658]], [[Northkeep|165638]] and [[Oars Rest|41812]] add places that were never there.
- Living in it: [[Gourmet|96876]] for cooking, [[Fishing in Skyrim|47618]], and lutes, flutes and drums you can play ([[Playable Flute Lute and Drum|114877]]). Carriages and ferries run between the holds ([[Carriage and Ferry Travel Overhaul|8379]]). Hunger, thirst, tiredness and the cold are the server's own needs, not a mod's.
- Magic: [[Odin|46000]], [[Apocalypse|1090]] and [[Triumvirate|39170]].
- Gear: [[Immersive Armors|3479]], [[Immersive Weapons|16788]], [[Zim's Immersive Artifacts|9138]], [[New Legion|30468]], [[Cloaks and Capes|2019]] and [[More Craftable Equipment|44666]].
- Interface: [[SkyUI|12604]], [[SkyHUD|463]], [[moreHUD|12688]], [[TrueHUD|62775]], [[A Quality World Map|5804]] and [[Better Container Controls|25271]].
- How it looks and moves: [[Cathedral Weathers|24791]], [[Water for ENB|37061]], [[Embers XD|37085]], [[Happy Little Trees|50961]], [[Deadly Spell Impacts|12939]], [[True Directional Movement|51614]] and [[Precision|72347]].
- Starting: [[Skyrim Unbound Reborn|27962]], so you are not in the cart every time.
- The framework, which comes with the collection: [[SKSE|30379]], [[Address Library|32444]], [[Engine Fixes|17230]], [[powerofthree's Tweaks|51073]], [[Papyrus Extender|22854]], [[Open Animation Replacer|92109]], [[SSE Display Tweaks|34705]], [[Crash Logger|59818]], [[SkyPatcher|106659]], [[NirnLab UI Platform|125447]], [[Thornswood Content|192001]] and [[Thornswood Client Runtime|192762]].

## Before you start

- Skyrim Special Edition on Steam, launched once so it writes its settings.
- Vortex, with a free Nexus account.
- The Thornswood launcher from https://thornswood.net.

## Everything is required

There are no optional mods in this collection. The server compares your plugins with its own: each one's name, its place in the order, its size and its checksum. One that is missing, out of place or changed turns you away before you load in.

Do not add your own plugins to this profile. Textures, meshes, sounds and weather are not part of that check and are yours to change. An extra esp, esm or esl is, and it stops you connecting. Keep those in your own profile.

Purge Mods in Vortex takes away everything this collection deployed and leaves your game folder as it was. Nothing is deleted, and Deploy puts it all back.

## Keeping it working

Stay on the exact versions this collection pins, and do not update its mods yourself. Always start the game from the Thornswood launcher. After any change, deploy in Vortex before you play.

## Recommended specs

- GPU: GTX 1060 or RX 580 or better, at 1080p.
- RAM: 16 GB, 32 GB preferred.
- CPU: four cores or more.
- An SSD, strongly recommended.

## Other collections

None. Do not stack other large Skyrim collections with Thornswood.
installInstructions:
1. Install the Thornswood launcher from https://thornswood.net and open it once.
2. Add this collection in Vortex and let it install everything into its own profile.
3. Press Play in the launcher. It checks your mods against the server and starts the game.

notSaid.why: the build keeps Start On Save out because it crashed the game, so the collection does not install it.
the needs are the server's own, not a mod's, and Tempt is no mod the collection installs.
the Steam copy can be on any build: the launcher's Downgrade fetches 1.6.1170 for Thornswood's own folder (site/data/site/join.md).
the server also compares each plugin's size and checksum (records/collection-plugins.json).
the launcher builds the behavior files itself, with Pandora, and nobody runs Nemesis (scripts/mods/Build-Generated.ps1).
the launcher builds the body meshes itself, and nobody runs BodySlide by hand (scripts/mods/Build-Generated.ps1).
the load order is the collection's own rules, and LOOT would sort it some other way.
